detailed_descriptions.en: Wing Commander: Prophecy is an action-packed combination of one of the best sci-fi sim of the 1990s plus the amazing Secret Ops episodes. Now celebrated in this special 30th Anniversary Edition, the game has been restored in collaboration with the dedicated Wing Commander community to deliver a must-see experience. 30th Anniversary Edition key improvements: Source Master FMVs - In 2022, the Source Master tapes were discovered in the EA physical media vault. These tapes have been digitized and meticulously re-edited frame-by-frame to restore the over 150 FMV scenes, and integrate them back into the game. Upscaled FMVs - As an optional enhancement, the FMVs have been further elevated to sharper quality using the latest in video upscaling technology for the best Wing Commander Prophecy cinematics ever seen. Enhancement Patch Integration - Bundled with the incredible Wing Commander Prophecy Enhancement Patch built by the Wing Commander community, enabling features like the higher resolution FMVs, advanced levels of detail, and more - Bonus extras including manuals, reference cards, player guides, and more - Cloud Saves This 30th Anniversary Edition is the ultimate way to enjoy one of the most important franchises in gaming history. Original Game Descriptions: WING COMMANDER PROPHECY BREATHTAKING GRAPHICS Amazingly detailed spaceships, dazzling explosions, intense lighting effects and more! SPACE SIM OF THE YEAR Features all the award-winning space combat action that made Wing Commander: Prophecy the king of all space simulations. INTENSE STORY A gripping story line unfolds as each mission you fly affects your wingmates and the outcome of the war. Experience more than 100 pulse-pounding space combat missions in all! STAR QUALITY Stunning cinematic sequences feature return performances by Mark Hamill, Tom Wilson, Ginger Lynn Allen and introducing Steven Petrarca as Casey. WING COMMANDER PROPHECY SECRET OPS INTENSE BATTLE SCENARIOS Multi-stage capital ship strike missions create larger, more intense battles. NEW WEAPON TECHNOLOGY Command the galaxy with new rapid fire weapons such as the Dust Cannon, Cloud Burst and Mosquito Missiles. MORE INTENSE STORY Continuing where Prophecy left off, join the Confederation Intelligence Services and fight for mankind’s very survival. All Pilots Report for Duty!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Wing Commander: Prophecy is an action-packed combination of one of the best sci-fi sim of the 1990s plus the amazing Secret Ops episodes.

Now celebrated in this special 30th Anniversary Edition, the game has been restored in collaboration with the dedicated Wing Commander community to deliver a must-see experience.

30th Anniversary Edition key improvements:

Source Master FMVs - In 2022, the Source Master tapes were discovered in the EA physical media vault. These tapes have been digitized and meticulously re-edited frame-by-frame to restore the over 150 FMV scenes, and integrate them back into the game.

Upscaled FMVs - As an optional enhancement, the FMVs have been further elevated to sharper quality using the latest in video upscaling technology for the best Wing Commander Prophecy cinematics ever seen.


Enhancement Patch Integration - Bundled with the incredible Wing Commander Prophecy Enhancement Patch built by the Wing Commander community, enabling features like the higher resolution FMVs, advanced levels of detail, and more


- Bonus extras including manuals, reference cards, player guides, and more

- Cloud Saves

This 30th Anniversary Edition is the ultimate way to enjoy one of the most important franchises in gaming history.


Original Game Descriptions:

WING COMMANDER PROPHECY

BREATHTAKING GRAPHICS
Amazingly detailed spaceships, dazzling explosions, intense lighting effects and more!

SPACE SIM OF THE YEAR
Features all the award-winning space combat action that made Wing Commander: Prophecy the king of all space simulations.

INTENSE STORY
A gripping story line unfolds as each mission you fly affects your wingmates and the outcome of the war. Experience more than 100 pulse-pounding space combat missions in all!

STAR QUALITY
Stunning cinematic sequences feature return performances by Mark Hamill, Tom Wilson, Ginger Lynn Allen and introducing Steven Petrarca as Casey.

WING COMMANDER PROPHECY SECRET OPS

INTENSE BATTLE SCENARIOS
Multi-stage capital ship strike missions create larger, more intense battles.

NEW WEAPON TECHNOLOGY
Command the galaxy with new rapid fire weapons such as the Dust Cannon, Cloud Burst and Mosquito Missiles.

POWERFUL NEW STARSHIPS
Introducing Cerberus, Confed’s first “Quick-Strike” Carrier, new Cruisers, Destroyers and civilian cruiseliners.

MORE INTENSE STORY
Continuing where Prophecy left off, join the Confederation Intelligence Services and fight for mankind’s very survival.

All Pilots Report for Duty!
